prospect.countryHelp: Use a two-letter code, such as US or GB.
prospect.findingHelp: Describe what the named product page actually showed. Keep the supporting source separate from the email.
prospect.verificationHelp: Only record a verified address when a provider has confirmed it. A public or guessed address is not a verification result.
prospect.personalHelp: Use a true work-related detail published within nine months. Open its public source within the last day and record both dates. Leave the line blank when there is no useful detail.
prospect.timeHelp: Use an IANA time zone, such as America/New_York.
prospect.dateHelp: Use an ISO date and time, including the time-zone offset.
prospect.legitHelp: Record sourced evidence of funding, at least three real team members, or distribution through another retailer.

prospect.distributionSourceHelp: Link to the same product at another retailer. Required for the claim about matching listings across stores.
prospect.findingReviewedHelp: Check this product’s raw and rendered data and the finding’s exceptions before confirming. Saving this check does not approve the email.

playbook.templateHelp: Use the writer's opening, result and relevance once each. Keep the founder line, chat ask, opt-out and signature as separate configured controls.
playbook.changeNote: Changing templates does not approve existing messages. Review any regenerated drafts before sending.
playbook.capHelp: The daily cap includes first emails and follow-ups.
playbook.legalHelp: Country settings are an eligibility control, not legal permission to contact someone. Keep unreviewed countries on hold.
playbook.sendingHelp: Only approved messages that pass every current check can enter the sending queue.
playbook.senderHelp: Confirm that the display name, signature and founder statements truthfully identify the sender.

validation.gap: The maximum gap must be at least the minimum gap.
validation.followup: The second follow-up must come after the first.

playbook.releaseHelp: Confirm these checks before enabling delivery. Approving messages does not enable sending.
playbook.senderPoolHelp: These inbox addresses use the same sender name and signature above. They are aliases for one person, not separate team members.
playbook.examplesHelp: Paste emails you have reviewed and approved as writing examples. Their voice guides the writer; facts and recipients must still come from each prospect’s saved evidence.
playbook.writingHelp: Shopping reason, saved result, reason to care, then the configured founder line and one chat ask. Fixed wording stays exactly as configured.
playbook.humanizerHelp: Polish AI drafts with Humanizer before review. New drafts keep the template's sender lines and closing.
playbook.humanizerNotesHelp: Edit the cleanup guidance. Your sent examples guide the voice. Turning Humanizer off keeps these notes for later.
playbook.inactiveSenderHelp: Keep additional sender aliases here while their connections are pending. They can sync history when connected but cannot send until moved to the active list.
playbook.emailVerificationHelp: Maximum age of the provider’s actual verification receipt. Fetching an older record does not renew it.
playbook.productVerificationHelp: Maximum age of product evidence when older saved research is not allowed.
playbook.excludedCompaniesHelp: One exact company name or known alias per line. Matches company names, not website text.
playbook.targetingNotesHelp: Priorities and review guidance for staff. These notes do not add automatic eligibility checks.
playbook.replyClaimNotesHelp: Reference wording for replies and LinkedIn. These notes do not authorize claims in a first email.
playbook.firstEmailBlockedClaimsHelp: One claim, company name or phrase per line. Matches block first-email approval. Percentages are also blocked.
playbook.findingRulesHelp: These lines set the observation, proposed check and question topic. The placeholders below use saved prospect facts; productFeature is a source-matched buying detail.
playbook.barcodeHelp: Confirm a valid store barcode is absent from raw and rendered product data, and link proof that the same product is sold elsewhere.
playbook.reviewsHelp: Confirm the visible review count belongs to this product and rating data is absent from both the source and rendered page.
playbook.noBarcodeHelp: Use only for packaged goods. Exclude gift cards, custom or handmade goods, bundles, digital items and samples.
playbook.noProductHelp: Confirm product data is absent from both the source and the page after JavaScript runs.
playbook.automationHelp: Active campaigns can find contacts, verify work emails, prepare messages and approve eligible emails automatically. Delivery still follows the sending switch, mailbox readiness and saved limits.
playbook.dailyCompanyTargetHelp: Minimum discovery target across all active campaigns each UTC day. Discovery can continue to replenish research. Companies still need qualification; this does not set email volume.
playbook.productCheckIntroHelp: Used when the email cites a saved AI answer. Each connected sender keeps their own saved founder line.
playbook.publishedProductHelp: Use '{productFeature}' for a specific ingredient, material, design or compatibility detail found on the named product. Frame the AI question as a check we propose, never a measured result or missing-data claim.
playbook.automaticChangeNote: Changes apply to subsequent checks and drafts. Messages that no longer match the Playbook are held.
playbook.automaticSendingHelp: Only messages that pass automatic checks and current delivery conditions can enter the sending queue.
playbook.linkedinAutomationHelp: Automatically process eligible LinkedIn contacts using the selected connected account. Email sending is controlled separately.
playbook.linkedinAccountHelp: Choose the connected account that will send invitations and messages. No account is selected automatically.
playbook.linkedinCapsHelp: LinkedIn has separate limits: at most 15 invitations per day, 50 per week and 15 messages per day. These are ceilings; account state and eligibility checks can hold activity.
playbook.meetingBookingUrlHelp: The HTTPS booking link used in replies. A link click never marks a meeting as booked.
playbook.researchHelp: Ground each unbranded search in the rendered product page. Save the complete answer and its links before deciding what the email may say.
playbook.researchInstructionsHelp: Describe the shopper questions, exact variants and markets to compare, and evidence to collect from UCP, product pages or checkout. Record sources and leave untested or unavailable results unknown.
playbook.requireShoppingEvidenceHelp: Hold drafting and approval until a supported shopping finding is recorded. An ingredient fact alone is not evidence of shopping friction.
playbook.legacyFindingsHelp: Saved formulas for older product and missing-data checks. When shopping evidence is required, new drafts use the recorded shopping finding instead. These fields remain available for older workflows.
playbook.allowIncompleteHistoryHelp: You can skip importing past campaigns. Someone may hear from us again; recorded opt-outs, bounces and exclusions still apply.
playbook.allowStaleEvidenceHelp: Use real saved research after its age limit. Original observation dates stay visible; missing evidence, replies and opt-outs still prevent sending.
playbook.sendingRampHelp: Start at 15 emails a day and increase after completed sending days. Turn off to use your configured daily limit directly; bounce protection still applies.
playbook.trustSavedContactVerificationHelp: Accept source-verified imported contacts without claiming a new verification or role check. Original dates, including unknown dates, are preserved.
playbook.automaticApolloHelp: Use Apollo for new companies, enrichment and email verification. Turn off to work from saved records without new paid Apollo requests.
playbook.allowProductObservationsHelp: Keep leads with a supported product observation for a grounded discovery search. An observation alone does not approve an email or a no-gap finding.
playbook.allowUsMarketWindowHelp: For contacts recorded in the United States with no saved timezone, allow Monday–Thursday, 18:00–21:00 UTC. This is your chosen market window, not a verified personal location. Known timezones keep 08:00–14:00 local sending. Off by default.
playbook.allowMicrosoftRecipientsHelp: Allow verified work email addresses hosted by Microsoft. Unknown mail hosts, unverified addresses, replies, opt-outs and all other sending checks still apply. Off by default.
playbook.wordTargetHelp: Aim for 70–90 words. Hard limit: 99, including greeting, opt-out and signature.
playbook.relevanceLinesHelp: One approved idea per row. The writer may adapt supported category wording; it cannot add a measured business result.
playbook.queryStyleHelp: Suggest uses or occasions to prefer. Every query still needs a category and one detail stated on the product page, with no brand or product name.
playbook.searchesPerLeadHelp: Choose 1 or 2. A second, broader search is allowed only when the first answer puts the store first and gets it right.
playbook.discoveryFreshnessDaysHelp: Choose 1–7 days. Older absence or ranking findings need a fresh search, even when older page evidence is allowed.
playbook.founderLineHelp: Used for a finding in the product page's own data. Keep this author's identity and biography accurate.
playbook.proposalHelp: Load the proposed formula into this form to review it. Sender identities, founder lines, approved examples and research settings stay as saved.
playbook.proposalLoaded: Proposal loaded locally. Review the fields, then save only when you are ready to adopt it.
playbook.iseldProposalTitle: Proposed founder wording for Iseld only
playbook.iseldProposalHelp: Reference only. These lines are not loaded into the form or any sender profile. The Shopify Plus biography belongs only to Iseld.

errors.provider-unavailable: The provider is unavailable. Check the latest request before trying again.
errors.campaign-criteria-changed: Campaign criteria changed. Reload and review the current version.
errors.campaign-paused: Resume this campaign in its settings before searching.
errors.campaign-run-unresolved: An earlier request is still running or needs reconciliation. Check it before another batch.
errors.campaign-source-exhausted: This source has no more results for the current criteria. Choose another source or revise the criteria.
errors.provider-plan-required: Your Apollo plan does not include platform filters. Start an eligible trial or upgrade the plan, then retry.
errors.provider-clay-plan-required: Clay requires a paid plan for these company filters. Upgrade Clay before running this search.
errors.campaign-generation-invalid: This Claude preview is no longer available. Generate a new preview before saving.
errors.campaign-playbook-changed: The Playbook changed after this preview was generated. Generate a new preview before saving.
errors.campaign-archived: This campaign is archived. Change its status before generating criteria.
errors.apollo-paused: Automatic Apollo requests are paused in the Playbook. Saved work can continue.

campaigns.objectiveHelp: Describe the audience. Use the structured filters below for provider searches.
campaigns.qualificationHelp: A staff review checklist. Provider search does not automatically verify these requirements.
campaigns.discoverySavedCriteria: Search uses saved criteria version {version}. Save your preview or edits before searching with them.

discoverySourceHelp.auto: Find up to 25 companies per request. Apollo runs first; Clay continues after Apollo’s results are exhausted. Provider errors stop the search.
discoverySourceHelp.apollo: Search up to 25 companies in Apollo using this campaign’s saved criteria.
discoverySourceHelp.clay: Search up to 25 companies in Clay using this campaign’s saved criteria.

campaigns.discoveryPreviewPending: A criteria preview is waiting for review. Save or discard it before finding companies.
campaigns.companySearchFailedDescription: No companies were added. Resolve the issue shown above, then retry.
campaigns.automaticContactsHelp: Active campaigns check each matched company, find and verify a contact, then draft and queue its email sequence automatically. Opening a contact is optional; delivery checks still apply.

forms.changed: This campaign changed. Your values are kept. Load the saved values before continuing.
forms.loadSaved: Discard edits and load saved values

warmup.title: Warmup
warmup.description: Check mailbox setup and prepare a gradual sending plan for your domains.
warmup.networkHelp: Warmbly’s shared network is the selected warmup route. Connect the network before starting traffic; mailbox checks and saved plans remain available.
warmup.scopeHelp: These checks cover DNS records, mailbox access and saved readiness confirmations. Inbox placement and reputation remain unknown.
warmup.emptyDescription: Add your inbox addresses to the Playbook, then connect them in Integrations.
warmup.checkHelp: Check domain records, mailbox access and synchronization. This check does not send an email.
warmup.dkimHelp: Use the selectors supplied by your email host, separated by commas. Leave blank to keep DKIM unknown.
warmup.uncheckedHelp: Run a check to save the first observation for this mailbox.
warmup.planHelp: Save the starting volume, daily increase and ceiling for Warmbly. Sender and Playbook limits still apply.
warmup.invalidPlan: Use whole numbers. The maximum must be at least the starting volume and no more than 15.
warmup.planScope: Saving this plan does not start warmup. Warmbly manages the daily ramp and can hold or reduce volume based on its observations. This preview shows configured limits, not recorded mailbox health.
warmup.loadError: Couldn’t load mailbox information. Reload the page.
warmup.missingMailbox: This address is not in the Playbook’s sender inboxes.

warmbly.title: Warmbly network
warmbly.description: Connect your Warmbly account to manage shared-network warmup here. Connect the mailboxes in Warmbly; mailbox passwords are not transferred from Outbound.
warmbly.keyHelp: Use a workspace key with READ_EMAILS and WRITE_EMAILS permissions. The key is verified and stored encrypted; saved keys are never displayed.
warmbly.invalidKey: Enter a valid Warmbly workspace API key.
warmbly.checksRequired: Save a volume plan and pass a fresh DNS and mailbox check before starting. The mailbox must be active in Warmbly.
warmbly.startHelp: Start and Resume apply the saved volume plan before activating network warmup. Outbound delivery is held for that inbox while network warmup runs.
warmbly.pendingHelp: An earlier action needs a status check. Refresh before retrying so it is not repeated.
warmbly.emptyTitle: No registered inboxes on this page
warmbly.emptyDescription: Connect inboxes in Warmbly and save the same addresses in the Playbook. If there are more pages, continue to find them.
warmbly.loadError: Couldn’t load the Warmbly network. Check the connection and refresh.
warmbly.actionError: Couldn’t complete this action. Refresh the network and check its permissions and limits before trying again.
warmbly.accessError: Warmbly rejected access. Check the API key and its READ_EMAILS and WRITE_EMAILS permissions.
warmbly.readinessError: Run a fresh mailbox check and resolve MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC before starting.
warmbly.limitError: The saved volume ceiling exceeds the Playbook or mailbox limit. Lower it before starting.
warmbly.activeError: Activate this mailbox in Warmbly before starting warmup.
warmbly.rampError: Warmbly has not confirmed the saved volume plan. Refresh its status before trying again.
warmbly.planChangedError: The volume plan changed during setup. Refresh before starting.
warmbly.stateError: Warmbly has not confirmed the requested state. Refresh to check the outcome before another action.
warmbly.registeredError: Save this exact mailbox address in the Playbook before managing its warmup.

errors.provider-key-invalid: Enter a valid Warmbly workspace API key.
errors.provider-key-unavailable: Couldn’t load the Warmbly network. Check the connection and refresh.
errors.provider-key-encryption: Couldn’t complete this action. Refresh the network and check its permissions and limits before trying again.
errors.provider-key-save-failed: Couldn’t complete this action. Refresh the network and check its permissions and limits before trying again.

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: Draft campaign criteria with Claude, then review every change before saving.
claude.setupHelp: Create a Claude Console API key and connect it here.
claude.billingHelp: API requests use your Console balance and any eligible credits. Verifying the key does not confirm the available API balance.
claude.keyHelp: The key is verified and encrypted before storage. Saved keys are never shown again.
claude.workspaceHelp: Leave blank for a workspace-scoped key. Otherwise enter your Console workspace ID.
claude.unknown: Could not read the Claude connection status.
claude.keySaved: Claude API key verified and saved.
claude.saveError: Could not save the Claude connection. Please try again.
claude.connectHelp: Connect your Claude API key in Integrations to draft criteria here.
claude.generationHelp: Claude uses this campaign’s saved criteria, your Playbook and the context below. It prepares a preview for your review; nothing is saved automatically.
claude.contextHelp: Describe the companies you want, constraints or changes to the saved criteria. Claude does not automatically read your Claude app conversations or memory.
claude.previewReady: Claude preview ready. Review the fields below before saving.
claude.previewPending: Save or discard the current preview before generating another.
claude.recoveryHelp: This browser remembers the last Claude request for this campaign. Recover preview checks it without generating again. A new generation may use more credits, even if the previous response did not arrive.
claude.stalePreview: The campaign criteria changed. Refresh the page and generate a new preview.
claude.generationError: Could not retrieve the Claude preview. Try recovering it before starting another request.

errors.claude-not-configured: Connect a Claude API key in Integrations first.
errors.claude-access-denied: Claude rejected access. Check the API key and workspace in Integrations.
errors.claude-credit-required: Claude needs available API credit. Check your Console balance and eligible credits.
errors.claude-rate-limited: Claude is rate limited. Wait before starting another request.
errors.claude-model-unavailable: This Claude model is not available to the connected key. Choose another model in Integrations.
errors.claude-request-invalid: Claude could not accept this request. Check the context and campaign criteria.
errors.claude-generation-running: Claude is still processing this request. Try recovering the preview in a moment.
errors.claude-generation-uncertain: The request’s outcome is uncertain. Recover the preview before considering a new generation.
errors.claude-generation-failed: This generation did not produce a usable preview. Review the context before generating again.
errors.claude-generation-missing: No saved preview was found for this request. You can explicitly start a new generation.
errors.provider-key-invalid: Check the credentials and required fields, then try again.
errors.provider-key-unavailable: The provider could not be reached. Please try again.
errors.provider-key-encryption: The server could not encrypt these credentials. Ask an administrator to check its encryption configuration.
errors.provider-key-save-failed: Could not save these credentials. Please try again.
errors.campaign-archived: This campaign is archived. Change its status before generating criteria.
errors.campaign-criteria-changed: Campaign criteria changed. Reload and review the current version.

claude.creditsHelp: If your subscription includes API credits, claim them in Claude → Settings → Billing → API credits and link the Console organization that owns this key.
claude.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage to save and recover Claude previews. No new generation was started.

automation.title: Automatic campaign work
automation.help: Active campaigns continue in the background. Run now processes the next available work.
automation.enableHelp: Enable Automatic mode in the Playbook to start automatic campaign work.
automation.previewPending: Automatic work uses saved criteria. Save or discard the preview before starting work here.
automation.pauseHelp: Pausing stops new preparation steps. A request already in progress may finish.
automation.statusError: Status could not be refreshed. The displayed data may be out of date.
automation.actionError: This action could not be completed. Refresh the status and try again.
automation.campaignStarted: Campaign activated. Its next preparation work was checked.
automation.runComplete: The next available work was checked.
automation.preparedHelp: Prepared means the contact and messages passed preparation. The delivery worker still checks each email before sending.
automation.empty: No preparation records yet. Activate a campaign with saved companies to begin.
automation.deliveryHelp: Every email still follows live delivery checks, pacing, suppression and warmup holds.

reasons.campaign-criteria-changed: Campaign criteria changed; this work is held.
reasons.playbook-changed: The Playbook changed; this work is held.
reasons.company-unavailable: The company is excluded or no longer available.
reasons.qualification-held: Company or product evidence did not pass.
reasons.contact-held: No eligible current contact was confirmed.
reasons.email-held: A suitable work email was not found.
reasons.mx-held: The email host did not pass checks.
reasons.draft-held: The draft did not pass writing checks.
reasons.approval-held: The message did not pass final eligibility checks.
reasons.provider-input: The provider could not process this input.
reasons.lease-expired: An earlier request did not finish cleanly. Check its recorded outcome.
reasons.provider-configuration: Connect this provider in Integrations before searching.
reasons.provider-access: The provider rejected access. Check the API key and search access in Integrations.
reasons.provider-quota: The provider’s credit or usage limit has been reached. Check your provider plan.
reasons.provider-rate-limit: The provider has temporarily limited requests. Wait before starting another batch.
reasons.provider-uncertain: The request may have been processed. Check its outcome before trying again.
reasons.research-not-configured: Connect the shopping research services in Integrations.
reasons.shopping-research-held: Shopping research did not establish a supported finding.
reasons.shopping-research-expired: Shopping evidence has expired; capture it again.
reasons.apollo-paused: Automatic Apollo requests are paused in the Playbook. Saved work can continue.

deliveryBlockers.sendingPaused: Sending is paused in the Playbook.
deliveryBlockers.historyUnconfirmed: Past sends and exclusions are not confirmed as imported.
deliveryBlockers.competingSendersActive: Other sending systems have not been confirmed paused.
deliveryBlockers.senderUntested: A sender test has not been confirmed.
deliveryBlockers.inboxesMissing: One or more active sender mailboxes are not connected.
deliveryBlockers.inboxDisabled: A sender mailbox is disabled or disconnected.
deliveryBlockers.inboxSyncIncomplete: Mailbox history or reply sync needs attention.
deliveryBlockers.senderIdentityMismatch: A mailbox does not match the saved sender identity.

automation.rampHelp: Mailboxes start at 15 per day. The limit rises by 5 only after a completed day reaches the current limit without an observed bounce. An observed bounce returns the limit to 15. A target does not guarantee sending volume or inbox reputation.

research.missingHelp: Connect {providers} in Integrations to prepare new prospects with observed shopping evidence.
research.blockedHelp: Check API access and available credits for {providers}. Research is paused while this connection needs attention.

sent.title: Sent
sent.description: Accepted emails and sending attempts, with the saved message and follow-up history.
sent.detailDescription: The recorded content, provider result and activity for this conversation.
sent.searchPlaceholder: Recipient, company, campaign, inbox or subject
sent.count: {count, plural, one {# recorded attempt} other {# recorded attempts}}
sent.emptyDescription: Messages appear here when Outbound records an attempt to send them.
sent.error: Sent messages could not be loaded. Try again.
sent.missing: This sending record could not be found.
sent.acceptanceNote: Accepted means the email provider accepted the message. It does not confirm inbox delivery.

sequence.title: Follow-up sequence
sequence.scheduleNote: Scheduled follow-ups still depend on the sending window and delivery checks.
sequence.bounceNote: The bounce belongs to this conversation; the stored receipt does not identify a specific step.
sequence.emptyActivity: No reply or delivery activity has been recorded yet.

message.title: Saved message
message.subject: Subject
message.contentMissing: The immutable message record is missing or its integrity check failed. Current draft text is not shown as sent content.
message.failed: This attempt failed; this content is not confirmed as sent.
message.uncertain: The outcome is unknown. This content may have been sent; no automatic retry is implied.
message.claimed: This attempt has been prepared; provider acceptance has not been recorded.

pipeline.title: From companies to conversations
pipeline.description: Find relevant companies, research a useful insight, and follow each conversation through to a meeting.
pipeline.meetingsHelp: Only meetings explicitly recorded as held are counted. Bookings and booking links are not held meetings.
pipeline.scopeHelp: Company and contact counts use active campaigns and their current saved criteria. A company in research is not yet a contact.
pipeline.moreCampaigns: Showing the latest active campaigns. Open Campaigns to see them all.
pipeline.emptyHelp: Create a campaign, save its targeting criteria and find companies to start the workflow.
pipeline.workEmpty: No current preparation work needs attention. Campaigns show the complete history.
pipeline.setupReady: Connection settings are present. Live identity, reply, pacing and delivery checks still run before each send.
pipeline.activityTitle: Accepted in the last seven days
pipeline.acceptedHelp: Acceptance confirms the provider accepted a message; it does not prove inbox delivery.
pipeline.automationHelp: Enable automatic mode in the Playbook to continue campaign preparation.
pipeline.apolloMissing: Connect Apollo to find companies and current contacts.
pipeline.azureMissing: Configure Azure to assess evidence and prepare messages.
pipeline.linkedinMissing: Connect the selected LinkedIn account before enabling its messages.
pipeline.error: Couldn’t load the current pipeline. Refresh to try again.
pipeline.pipelineHelp: Counts from active campaigns at their current criteria revision. These are saved records, not conversion rates.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Read replies, answer with context and turn interest into a meeting.
conversations.detailDescription: The actual conversation, your reply and the next step in one place.
conversations.emptyDescription: Connected inbox and LinkedIn reply checks save actual messages here. Older outcome notes remain in each prospect’s activity.
conversations.meetingHelp: Mark a meeting booked only after it is confirmed, and held after it happens. Sharing the booking link does not record a booking.
conversations.replyHelp: Suggestions use the conversation and saved Playbook. Review the exact text, save any changes, then send from the connected account shown above.
conversations.recoveryHelp: A suggestion was requested. Check the same request to recover a saved result without starting another generation.
conversations.unsaved: Save your reply edits before sending.

error.changed: The conversation changed. Reload it and review the latest message before continuing.
error.closed: This conversation is closed or the recipient has been excluded from contact.
error.stale: Read the latest inbound message and save a current reply before sending.
error.unresolved: A previous send is still running or its outcome is unknown. Another send is blocked until its result is reconciled.
error.truncated: The latest message is incomplete. Read the full message in the connected inbox before replying.
error.generationUncertain: The suggestion’s result is not confirmed. Checking this request will not generate another reply.
error.connection: The sending account is unavailable or needs a fresh reply sync. Check Integrations.
error.controls: The suggestion did not pass the saved reply controls. Write and review the reply yourself.
error.generic: We could not complete this action. Refresh the conversation and try again.
error.authentication: Your session expired. Sign in again in the new tab, then retry here. Your edits are kept.
error.archived: Restore this conversation before editing or sending a reply.

conversations.emptyBody: No text was included in this message.
conversations.truncated: Only part of this message was saved. Open the full message in the connected account.
conversations.emptyMessages: No message text has been saved yet.

activity.scheduledHelp: Saved email send times are shown here. Pauses, reply checks, recipient hours and inbox limits can delay them. LinkedIn actions have no fixed saved send time.
activity.sentHelp: Email, LinkedIn and conversation reply attempts. Accepted means the provider accepted the message; it does not prove delivery or an opened message.

editor.changed: The conversation changed. Your edits are kept. Review the current messages before continuing.
editor.followUpsPaused: Saving this stage pauses automatic email and LinkedIn outreach to this person. Reopening does not restart it.

archive.help: Archive keeps the history and stops automatic outreach for this person.
archive.archivedHelp: Archived conversations keep their history. Restoring makes this thread visible again; automatic outreach stays paused.
archive.restored: Conversation restored. Automatic outreach remains paused.

funnel.title: Measured funnel
funnel.scopeHelp: Includes held and archived history. Each contact counts once; test records are excluded.
funnel.researchHelp: Latest recorded research per contact. Blocked includes incomplete checks; a finding is not an approval.
funnel.currentHelp: Copy checks and approvals refer to the current saved revision.
funnel.outcomesHelp: Accepted emails mean transport acknowledgment, not delivery. Replies exclude automation. Positive replies are marked by staff; meetings must be recorded as held.
funnel.costHelp: Unique acknowledged search purchases for this contact pool divided by first emails ever approved. Unconfirmed requests are separate.
